definitions.explanation: A building where goods are manufactured or processed.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{工場|こうじょう}で{働|はたら}いています。
examples.english: My father works at a factory.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}は{日本|にほん}の{工場|こうじょう}で{作|つく}られました。
examples.english: This car was made at a factory in Japan.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}{見学|けんがく}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went on a factory tour.

notes:
{工場|こうじょう} means factory—a place where goods are manufactured.

COMPONENTS:
{工|こう} (craft) + {場|じょう} (place) = manufacturing place

READINGS:
- こうじょう: standard, larger factories
- こうば: smaller workshops, often family-run

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {工場|こうじょう}{見学|けんがく}: factory tour
- {工場|こうじょう}{長|ちょう}: factory manager
- {食品|しょくひん}{工場|こうじょう}: food factory
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{工場|こうじょう}: automobile plant

RELATED WORDS:
- {製造|せいぞう}: manufacturing
- {生産|せいさん}: production
- {工業|こうぎょう}: industry

CULTURAL NOTE:
{工場|こうじょう}{見学|けんがく} (factory tours) are popular in Japan—many food/beverage companies offer free tours with samples.
